routes.description:
Returns metadata about this ca-5gc-sim process and the owner contracts
it supports. Think of this endpoint as "who is this simulator process
and what does it serve?", not "who is UE-B?".

This endpoint never performs user-visible name/alias -> SUPI/IMSI
resolution. That cross-domain identity mapping belongs to
ca-provider-common and is exposed there as
POST /v1/subject-identities/lookup.
